newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX heat off late amid talk of big delivery.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX heat off late amid talk of big delivery.

text.p: NYMEX heating oil remained weaker late session Tuesday amid talk of a major player having taken delivery of a large amount of heating oil amid otherwise slack buying interest for heat.
"This delivery could weigh on the physical market since there is already so much supply out there," said a dealer.

At 1510 EST, the market's close, March heating oil was 1.18 cents lower at 64.10 cents a gallon. Still, heat was off its session low of 63.55 cents after weathering significant spread selling of March for April, traders said.
